lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a series of roughly circular, high-luminance pixel clusters. Larger blobs (approx. 15-20 pixel diameters) are arranged in four distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a denser population of smaller spots (2-5 pixels) scattered anteriorly towards the head.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible on the mid-flank, intersecting with the larger high-luminance blobs to create a localized grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient showing high intensity on the dorsal edge and a shadowed low-intensity region immediately ventral.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible anterior portion of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 5-7 high-luminance spots, although the full fin silhouette is partially occluded by the upper image boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, bright white linear mark is visible at the junction where the pectoral fin meets the body. Additionally, several irregular notches are visible along the distal trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (likely remoras) appearing as dark, elongated silhouettes concentrated around the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
